paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with different language families. The horizontal axis displays language family labels, including Basque, Turkic, Semitic, IE-Indic, IE-other, IE-Baltic, Uralic, IE-Germanic, IE-Romance, and IE-Slavic, ordered from shortest to longest bar. The vertical axis represents the number of tasks, labeled as "# tasks", employing a linear scale from 0 to 80 and displaying tick labels at each 10-unit increment. The bars are colored in a range of hues, from light blue for IE-Slavic to dark blue for IE-Romance. The shortest bar, representing Basque, has an approximate value of 1, while the longest bar, representing IE-Slavic, has an approximate value of 68. The bars generally increase in height as one moves from bottom to top, with IE-other having an approximate value of 24, IE-Baltic having an approximate value of 31, and Uralic having an approximate value of 44; the bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and length.
